title: trainerframe
summary: The trainer session/window covers request/decode/buy/results, range expiry, authored ClassTrainer shell, live portrait/title, greeting, purse and detail MoneyFrame coin cells, 11-row faux scroll, detail pane, Train/Exit, and transition sounds. Its current tree is complete: learn wrappers hop through EffectTriggerSpell to the taught spell's SkillLine, tradeskill trainers partition Development Skills/Recipes, mount-known rows use My Talents, headers and All fold controls work, and the persistent Available/Unavailable/Already Known filter defaults to 1/1/0. Geometry and state derivation live in TrainerFrameUiLaw.

openItems.text: Flat list: no collapsible skill-line tree headers and no Collapse All control (Benilla/backport groups services under fold-able skill-line headers)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: TrainerFrameUiLaw builds an interleaved header/service tree from the exact trainer-type group law. Individual headers and the All control fold/unfold groups while the 11-row faux-scroll projects the visible tree.

openItems.text: No filter dropdown (Available / Unavailable / Already Known visibility toggles)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: The law-owned Filter dropdown toggles Available, Unavailable, and Already Known independently, retains the menu while toggling, resets scroll, and ships with the reference 1/1/0 defaults.

openItems.text: Title is the hardcoded string 'Trainer' - the NPC's name is never resolved into it
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: title resolves the bound creature name through the existing ask-once cache and retains the exact Trainer fallback.

openItems.text: No NPC portrait on the window ring
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: the bound trainer now renders through the shared live unit portrait path at the authored 7,6 / 60x60 region behind the shell ring.

openItems.text: No player money purse display, and cost renders as plain text rather than the coin-icon money rig with red unaffordable tint
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: player purse and detail cost render NumberFontNormal values plus UI-MoneyIcons cells; unaffordable selected costs use the reference red tint.
